{{dablink|For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
The '''Tower of Ravens''' is the central imperial prison of [[Seanchan]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tower of Ravens}}

It is located in the Seanchan capital city of [[Seandar]]. It serves as the primary headquarters of the [[Seekers for Truth]] and is used to incarcerate notable criminals, especially members of [[The Blood]]. For centuries Members of the Blood have been questioned and executed within the tower, though such executions must be done without spilling a single drop of their blood.{{ref/book|13|Glossary}}
